hooks.command: repo="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; mkdir -p "$repo/.claude/skills"; for d in "$repo"/.agents/skills/*/; do [ -d "$d" ] || continue; skill=$(basename "$d"); ln -sfn "$d" "$repo/.claude/skills/$skill"; done; [ -d "$repo/.agents/references" ] && ln -sfn "$repo/.agents/references" "$repo/.claude/references"
